text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Heading up to the rooftop for a change of 
pace...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
choice_data_list: Hey, what are you up to?
Hey, what are you up to?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer... I was just taking a 
breather.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The air here is so fresh and pleasant. I 
just can't help stopping by... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A peaceful time flows by... Let's refresh 
ourselves in this open space...
Sunshiiine!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you all sunbathing as well?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: P-Pearl-san...?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Being on the rooftop lets you feel closer 
to the sun, so it just fills you with 
energy!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The sunlight feels just right, it 
gives me energy.
Gwaaaah!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Wait, pleeease! I won't let you get away 
this tiiiime!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Whoa, El? W-What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Mambo is... No! I'm chasing after that 
condor, *desu*!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Escape from my room... No, that's not it! 
Umm, well, errr...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: T-That's right! We've been burgled, YES!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm gonna catch it, DEEEEESU!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
T-That's terrible...! I'll help you too! 
Let's catch it together!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I shall lend my aid as well! Charged with 
solar energy, I am utterly invincible!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hold on, hold ooon, DESU!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh! Just one more step out of 
reach...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"The opponent is a bird flying through the 
sky... I have to come up with some kind of 
strategy...!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Like, to get attention...?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Then leave it to me! I'll show you a 
dance that blazes like the sun! There's no 
way you can ignore this passion!!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Please! El, Trainer-san. Let's 
surround and catch them from three 
directions!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's a great strategy, *desu*! With 
that, we should definitely be able to 
catch Mambo... I mean, that condor, 
*desu*!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Alright, here I go! Foooooo!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mambo
text_block_list.text: Gwaaah?!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Alright, gotcha!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...! Thank you very much 
desu...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad that got sorted out! I was able 
to dance comfortably too, so I'm 
satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The storm passed, and tranquility returned 
once more to the rooftop.
choice_data_list: Did that help... refresh your mind?
Did that help... clear your head?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it was so lively it gave me energy. 
Made me realize, "Whoa, I really am at 
Tracen Academy."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Compared to when I was in the hospital, 
this was unthinkable... Every bit of life 
here at the academy feels like a miracle 
to me!
choice_data_list: Academy life really demands power, huh.

Academy life really demands power, doesn't 
it.

You'll naturally build up patience that 
way.

You'll naturally build up patience that 
way, right?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Compared to when I was in the hospital, 
this was unthinkable... Every bit of life 
here at the academy feels like a miracle 
to me!
choice_data_list: Academy life really demands power, huh.

Academy life really demands power, doesn't 
it.

You'll naturally build up patience that 
way.

You'll naturally build up patience that 
way, right?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... That's true. Every day is full 
of surprises, after all."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Still, being around such a lively group 
really inspires me. It naturally gives me 
energy.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by great friends and great 
rivals... I'm truly blessed, aren't I? I'm 
so glad I came here. Truly.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That might be true. At first, 
everything was full of surprises.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
“Still, nowadays barely anything surprises 
me anymore, maybe...”

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It feels like I've finally become a proper 
Tracen Academy student too. Fufu.
